verdict.rationale: The self-hosting docs describe the same engine as the hosted platform, shipped as a single self-contained binary on your own hardware with a local graph engine, local embeddings and a local LLM. They say data never leaves the building, and that it needs no Docker, no database to provision and no config files. That satisfies the 'against local models, without any cloud dependency' branch of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of an in-process embedded library mode (the evidence only shows a standalone binary), independent or hands-on corroboration of offline operation, and details on which local models are supported and on licensing or plan requirements for the self-hosted option.
